biotools.summary: GSFM is a computational framework for evaluating drug efficacy by transforming pharmacotranscriptomic profiles into genome-scale functional modules. It improves robustness and accuracy compared to other methods and identified candidate therapeutic agents validated through in vitro and in vivo experiments.
